title: Artefacts SMP
description: This is a french SMP with artefacts that grant you many powers.
body:
**Artefacts SMP** is a season-based, competitive survival server built around a single idea: **true power is rare, and it comes at a cost.**

Scattered across the world are hidden **Altars**, each one capable of forging a single legendary **Artefact** — a one-of-a-kind weapon or relic with a game-changing ability. A homing bow that never misses, a storm-calling trident, an explosive lance, the Dragon's Egg that doubles your health while you hold it… ten in total, each with its own recipe of rare, hard-won materials.

But there's one unbreakable rule: **no one may carry more than two Artefacts at once.** Every fight becomes a choice — what power do you bring, and what do you leave behind?

Survival here is sharp and honest. A **real combat system** tags you the moment you're struck, locking elytra, end crystals and respawn anchors so duels are won by skill, not by escaping. Forge alliances, build **teams**, raid your rivals — then brace yourself, because every season ends the same way: a **closing world border** forces all survivors into a final, winner-takes-all **Battle Royale**.

Before the season even begins, a **placement tournament** of 1v1 duels ranks every player, and a full **custom resource pack** brings each Artefact to life in 3D.

**Forge legends. Carry only two. Survive the collapse.**

▶️ **How to join** — Access to the server runs **entirely through our Discord**. Join the Discord, head to the **registration channel**, and sign up to get the **Registered** role that grants you entry to the SMP. **No Discord registration, no access.** That's also where the placement tournament, rankings and announcements happen.
